body.name: Strong-donor class \(\mathcal P_n\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_n=\{P=P_{A,u,v}:\operatorname{rank}(A)=r,\ cn\le s_r(A)\le s_1(A)\le C_0n,\ \max(\|U\|_{2,\infty},\|V\|_{2,\infty})\le\sqrt{\mu r/n},\ \max(\|A\|_{\max},\|u\|_\infty,\|v\|_\infty)\le B,\ u\in\operatorname{row}(A),\ v\in\operatorname{col}(A),\ \operatorname{vec}(E,e,f)\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2I_{n^2+2n}),\ 1\le r\le r_0\}\)
